race.description: Emmetts Thank You John Jess Mdn Plate
race.comment: KHADIRA (10) raced once in the maiden preparation when fifth at Sandown over 1400m back on March 25. Rounded out preparations for the return with a nice Traralgon jumpout win, just needs to overcome the wide alley. COOL AZA BREEZE (5) ran below expectations last time after being in contention on the turn at Kembla Grange, finishing ninth and beaten 12 lengths. Stable often strikes with horses from NSW first-up in Vic, so treat with respect. OCEANELLA (6) is back after a break of seven months. At the last run before the layoff she finished seventh over 1200m at Seymour. Commenced last prep with a minor placing at Kyneton over 1203m and can kick off with a bold showing. NICALOHA (2) didn't do a lot last prep, but has won two trials ahead of this and draws perfectly.
